task: Build a data-driven Connections screen (list, add, remove, health, proxy start/stop) for connecting Claude Desktop, VS Code and Codex to CodeMie via the existing PTY/CLI plumbing.

key_reasoning.reason: Generalizes a single hardcoded Connect view into a data-driven list across the frontend view layer (index.html/renderer.js/styles.css), a new pure-JS parser module (mirroring signin-parse.js), the bridge layer (runner-bridge.js), and likely a new Rust command module (mirroring inspector.rs) — 3-4 components across 2-3 layers, reusing runAction/ensureAuthenticated as shared utilities.

The task's own stated dependency — CLI-team confirmation of the codemie proxy sub-command interface — is unresolved: only 'proxy connect desktop' and 'proxy stop' exist anywhere in this repo; list/status/disconnect and vscode/codex connect are unverified, so whether a new Rust command is even needed is an open architectural decision.

Closest patterns (findLoginError, parse_profile_status, runAction) cover CLI-output parsing and PTY execution but not: a multi-item list UI (no precedent in this codebase), health polling (running/stopped/unreachable, no existing logic), or output parsing for proxy connect/disconnect (no test scaffold to extend) — the enumerated edge/health/variant cases have no existing defensive-test template, so Technical Risk is bumped per the no-precedent-test-template rule. Single global PTY slot (state.rs) also requires new serialization logic for concurrent connect/disconnect/start/stop.

Estimated ~5 modified files (index.html, renderer.js, styles.css, runner-bridge.js, lib.rs) plus ~3-4 new files (proxy-parse.js, possibly commands/proxy.rs, new test files) across 3 directories (ui/, ui/test/, src-tauri/src/commands/).

Touches UI (frontend view), API/bridge (runner-bridge.js), Service (new Rust command layer), Infrastructure (single-slot PTY state requiring serialization across connect/disconnect/start/stop), and External (codemie CLI process) — full stack plus the integration layer, with cross-cutting PTY-slot coordination added in several layers.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped from L to XL: CLI proxy sub-command interface (list/status/disconnect, vscode/codex connect) is explicitly unconfirmed per the task's own stated dependency — architectural decisions (need for a new Rust command) remain unmade.

Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: acceptance criteria enumerate specific variant/health cases (connect/disconnect success-failure parsing, proxy running/stopped/unreachable) with no existing test template or output-parsing precedent for this CLI surface to extend.
